responsibility: This public target header exposes the NDS32 intrinsic programming interface seen by user code. It defines vector typedefs, enumerations for architectural system registers and cache/prefetch operation selectors, and a large set of macros mapping stable __nds32__ names onto GCC builtins for system control, interrupt, DSP, FPU, unaligned-access, and miscellaneous target operations, making it the user-facing companion to the backend builtin registration code.
